name: NituLabs AI Content Fixer – Smart AI to Boost Your Content Quality
author: NituLabs

sections.description:
Scan and fix weak WordPress content with AI. Human‑like rewrites, no auto changes. Free plan included.

🧠 Tired of low-quality or outdated posts dragging your SEO down?
✨ NituLabs AI Content Fixer scans, identifies, and enhances your content—automatically.

Whether you’re a blogger, marketer, agency, or website owner, NituLabs AI Content Fixer helps you find content issues like:

  • ☠️ Empty or lorem ipsum placeholders
  • ✂️ Very short or low-effort posts
  • ❌ Broken or missing media content
  • 😔 Outdated or generic AI content

Then it gives AI-powered suggestions to rewrite, expand, or enhance that content — making it clearer, smarter, and more SEO-friendly.

Perfect for:

  • Bloggers who want polished content without rewriting everything
  • Site owners who care about professionalism and SEO
  • Agencies managing multiple sites
  • Anyone allergic to boring, incomplete content 😅

🌟 No technical skills required. Just scan → review → fix!

🔥 Why WordPress users love NituLabs AI Content Fixer:

  • ✅ One-click scan – instantly analyzes posts and highlights weak content
  • ✅ AI rewrite button – boost content clarity, structure, length, and SEO appeal
  • ✅ No auto-changes – your approval is always required
  • ✅ Human-like, natural language fixes
  • ✅ Simple, intuitive interface – no training needed
  • ✅ Free usage included – get started without cost

Don’t waste time rewriting your site piece by piece. Let the AI do the heavy lifting so you can focus on growth.

Features

🎯 Smart AI Post Scanner – Find posts with low-quality or placeholder content
✍️ Instant AI Fix Suggestions – Get rewritten long-form content that’s SEO- and reader-friendly
👁️ Visual Fix Preview – See AI improvements before applying
🧪 Secure AJAX Engine – Built with performance and safety in mind
⚙️ Lightweight & Developer Friendly – WordPress-native architecture, just connect your REST API key to get started
🔐 Free Plan Included – Scan and fix without adding payment info
🚀 Optional Pro Plan – Unlock unlimited usage and priority support

Support

For support, visit our support forum on WordPress.org or email us at support@nitulabs.com.

🪄 Just activate, connect your API key, and let AI handle the boring stuff.
💡 You focus on growth. We’ll worry about the words.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP (nitulabs-ai-content-fixer.x.x.x.zip) to your computer.
  2. In WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, then click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. When the install finishes, click Activate.
  5. Go to Settings > AI Content Fixer and enter your REST API key to enable AI features.
  6. Go to Tools > AI Content Fixer to scan posts and pages across your site.
  7. Edit any post or page to fix content directly in the editor:
    • Gutenberg (block editor): open the AI Content Fixer panel in the sidebar or below the content.
    • Classic Editor: use the AI Content Fixer meta box beneath the editor.
      Start improving your content instantly 🚀
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes — you get 3 free scans & 3 free fixes. Perfect for small sites or testing the plugin. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited use.

Can it rewrite content automatically?

No — NituLabs AI Content Fixer never changes content without your approval. You stay in full control.

Is my content sent to a third-party AI?

Yes. When you enable AI features, your post title and content are sent securely to our backend for processing. We do not store your content.

Will this improve my SEO?

Absolutely! NituLabs AI Content Fixer focuses on readability, length, clarity, and overall content quality—all critical metrics for modern SEO.

Does this plugin share any data externally?

When enabled, the plugin sends post titles and content to https://ai-content-fixer.nitulabs.com for AI analysis and improvements. We do not store your content, and we do not sell or share your data. See our privacy policy: https://ai-content-fixer.nitulabs.com/privacy.html

Do I need to give consent?

Yes. You must explicitly check a box in the plugin settings to enable these features. Without consent, no data is transmitted externally.

Does it change my SEO/meta or links?

No. It only rewrites your post content when you approve the fix.

Who can use it (capabilities)?

By default, only Administrators (manage_options) can scan/fix sitewide.

Does it impact site speed?

No. All scans and fixes run in the admin via AJAX. There is no front-end impact.
